result.finding: Coding protocol frozen before any test-set coding or extraction (Spec sdl-db-01 v3): coding guideline v1, taxonomy v1 (classes unchanged from v0.1), correspondence table to XDL, WeChemSynOntology and Leong et al. 2022 (OntoLab/SAREF as a reference column), the shared coding/extraction prompt v1, and the input, validation and scoring scripts (pairing per Spec v3: score.py --r1-fam; bootstrap B=2000, percentile, seed 1). Refined on the 10 development papers only (extraction/rehearsal/README.md, rehearsals v0-v3; not evidence). No class may be added during test coding; items that do not fit are coded unmapped.
